description: Uploads a cloud media URL (or Studio host local fileName) to a project's Postiz destination and schedules/drafts/posts it. Loop: render_board → list_workspaces → list_postiz_destinations → list_postiz_integrations → share_to_postiz. Requires FLIPLETTERS_API_KEY. Prefer mediaUrl from flipletters_render_board.

destinationId.description: Postiz destination id on that project.

fileName.description: Local renders/*.mp4 name when Studio host has the file.

mediaUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the MP4 (from cloud render).

providerType.description: Postiz provider __type, e.g. tiktok, x, linkedin.

name: flipletters_share_to_postiz
title: Schedule export on Postiz
